description: Source code for the agent monitoring task in prplMesh, handling agent events, message processing, statistics collection, and configuration management.

classes.name: agent_monitoring_task
classes.description: Manages agent monitoring, message handling, event processing, and statistics collection.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Performs scheduled work, including sending initial messages and deferring tasks based on M1 message bursts.

methods.name: handle_ieee1905_1_msg
methods.description: Processes incoming IEEE 1905 messages based on message type.

methods.name: start_agent_monitoring
methods.description: Initializes monitoring for a specific agent based on received data.

methods.name: schedule_task
methods.description: Schedules deferred tasks triggered by M1 messages.

methods.name: execute_deferred_task
methods.description: Executes queued configuration requests for an agent.

methods.name: send_multi_ap_policy_config_request
methods.description: Sends configuration request for multi-AP policy.

methods.name: send_backhaul_sta_capability_query
methods.description: Sends a backhaul STA capability query to an agent.

methods.name: send_prioritization
methods.description: Sends service prioritization rules to an agent.

methods.name: send_tlv_empty_channel_selection_request
methods.description: Requests empty channel selection from an agent.

methods.name: add_profile_2default_802q_settings_tlv
methods.description: Adds default 802.1Q VLAN settings TLV to a message.

methods.name: add_traffic_separation_policy_tlv
methods.description: Adds traffic separation policy TLV based on configuration.

methods.name: dm_add_sta_to_agent_connected_event
methods.description: Adds connected station info to agent event data model.

methods.name: dm_add_agent_connected_event
methods.description: Creates an agent connected event in the data model.

methods.name: dm_add_neighbor_to_agent_connected_event
methods.description: Adds neighbor information to agent event in the data model.

methods.name: save_bss_statistics
methods.description: Stores BSS statistics from received messages.

methods.name: save_radio_statistics
methods.description: Stores radio statistics from received messages.

methods.name: dm_add_agent_disconnected_event
methods.description: Creates an agent disconnected event in the data model.

methods.name: dm_set_agent_disconnected_event_params
methods.description: Sets parameters for agent disconnection event in the data model.
